book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Paththida Toho Sila Addeza
Hessafe kaallidi Ayhudata ba7aaley diza gishshas Yesusi Yerusalaame bides.
Yerusalaamen dorsi geliza penge achchan Ibraaweta qaalara, «Betesayda»
geetettiza issi pulttofe shiiqidi eellida haaththi dees; izappe bollara kamay diza ichchashu ogeti deettes.
Daro harganchchati, ayfe qooqeti, toho wobbetinne toho silati oge bolla ichchidi haaththi qaaxettana gakkanaas naageettes.
Issi issi wode Godaa kiitanchchay haaththaan wodhdhidi haaththa qaaththees; haaththaa qaaththafe kaallidi koyrottidi haaththaan geliza harganchchay bana sakkiza ay hargefekka paxees.
Heen heedzdzu tammanne osppun layth kumeth sakettida issaadey dees.
Yesusi addezi heen ichchidayssa be7idinne izi daro layth sakettidayssa eridi, «Ne paxana koyay?» gides.
Harganchchazikka zaaridi, «Godoo! Haaththay qaaxettiza wode tana haaththaan gelththiza asi deenna; ta buro baana gishin haray taappe kaseti haaththaan gelees» gides.
Yesusikka iza, «Denda! Ne ichchida algaa tookkada ba!» gides.
Addezikka heerakka paxides; ba algaa tookki ekkidi bides. Hessi haniday Ayhudata Sambata gallassa.
Hessa gishshas Ayhudata halaqati paxida addeza, «Hach Sambatara ne algaa tookkana mala Muse wogay azazenna» gida.
Izikka isttas, « ‹Ne ichchida algaa tookkada ba› gi yootides» gides.
Isttika, «Nena algaa tookkada ba giday oonee?» gi oychchida.
Derey darida gishshassinne Yesusi heeppe haakki bida gishshas iza ooni paththidaakko addezi eribeenna.
Hessafe guye Yesusi addeza Xoossa Keeththan demmidi, «Hekko ha7i ne paxadasa; kaseyssafe aadhdhiza iita miishshi ne bolla gakkontta mala nagara nam7anththo ooththofa» gides.
Addezikka biidinne iza paththiday Yesusa gididayssa Ayhudata halaqatas yootides.
Addeza Sambata gallas paththida gishshas Ayhudata daannati Yesusa oykkana yedeththida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Ta Aaway ubba wode ooththees; tanikka ooththana» gides;

Hessa gaason Ayhudata daannati Yesusa wodhana mala kaseppe aaththi denththeththida. Qasse izi Sambata moorida gishshas xalla gidontta, «Xoossi ta Aawa» gida gishshassinne bana Xoossara ginisida gishshassa.
Xoossa Naa Godateth
Yesusi isttas, «Ta inttes tumu gays; Aaway ooththishin be7idayssa oosoppe attiin naazi ba shenen aykkoka ooththenna. Aaway ooththizayssa iza nay hessaththoka ooththees.
Gaasoykka Aaway naaza dosees. Ba ooththizayssaka wursi iza bessees; intte malalettana mala hayssafekka aadhdhiza ooso buro bessana.
Aaway hayqqidayta denththizayssaththonne de7o immizayssaththo naazikka hessaththo ba koyidaades de7o immana.
Aaway oona bollaka pirdenna; gido attiin pirda maata ubbaa ba naazas immides.
Izi hessaththo ooththiday asay wuri Aawa bonchchana malanne qasseka naazakka bonchchana malassa. Naaza bonchchonttay naaza kiittida Aawaakka bonchchenna.
«Ta inttes tuma gays; ta qaalaa siyizaadessinne tana kiittidaaden ammanizaades mernaa de7oy dees. Izaadey hayqoppe gede de7on pinnides attiin iza bolla pirdettenna.
Ta inttes tuma gays; kase hayqqida asati Xoossa naa qaala siyiza wodey yaana; he wodeyakka hanno; siyizayti wuri de7on daana.
Gaasoykka Aaway ba baggara de7oy diza mala naazikka ba baggara de7oy daana mala ooththides.
Izi asa naa gidida gishshas pirdana mala godateth izas immides.
Hayssan aykkoka malalettofte. Gaasoykka kase hayqqidi duufon dizayti wuri iza qaala giiris siyiza wodey yaana.
Lo7o ooththidayti hayqoppe dendidi paxana. Gido attiin iita ooththidayti hayqoppe dendidi pirdettana.
Yesusas Markkattida Asata
«Tani ta shenen aykkoka ooththanaas dandaykke; gido attiin ta aawappe ta siyida mala pirdays. Tana kiittidayssa shene ooththays attiin ta shenen ta ooththontta gishshas ta pirdan balay baa.
Tani ta gishshas tarkka markkattiko ta markkay tumu gidenna.
Gido attiin ta gishshas markkattizaadey haray dees; izikka ta gishshas markkattizaade markkateththay tumu gididayssa ta erays.
Intte Yohannisakko ase kiittideta shin izikka tumu markkattides.
Ta hayssa gizay intte attana mala attiin taas hara markkateth koshshida gishshas gidenna.
Yohannisi eexxidi poo7isiza poo7o mala. Intteka guuththa wode iza poo7on ufayettana koyideta.
Taas gidikko Yohannisa markkateththafe aadhdhiza markkay dees. Ta markkayka ta Aaway taas immida ooso. Hessika ta ooththiza oosoy ta Aaway tana kiittidayssa taas markkattees.
Tana kiittida ta Aawaykka ba hu7era taas markkattides. Intte gidikko iza qaala giiris mulekka siyibeekketa; izas medhaakka mulera beyibeekketa.
Izi kiittidaaden intte ammanontta gishshas iza qaalay intte achchan deenna.
Inttes Geeshsha Maxaafatappe mernaa de7o demmanaas misatiin maxaafata pilggeeta; maxaafatikka ta gishshas markkatteettes.
Gido attiin intte de7o demmanaas taakko ha yaana koyekketa.
«Tani asappe bonchcho koykke.
Ta inttena erays; Xoossa siiqoy inttenan bayndayssaka erays.
Tani ta Aawa sunththan yadis shin intte tana mokki ekkibeekketa. Hara asi qasse ba sunththan yiikko intte iza mokki ekkeeta.
Intte intte giddon issoy issaafe bonchcho koyzaytoo! Issi Xoossafe beettiza bonchcho koyonttayto intte waanidi tana ammanana dandayeetii?
Ta Aawa sinththan inttena mootanay inttes tana misatoppo; inttena mootanay intte iza hidota ooththiza Muse.
Musey ta gishshas xaafidayssa ammanidaakko intte tana ammanana.
Izi xaafidayssa intte ammanontta aggiko qasse ta qaala intte waani ammananee?» gides.

footnotes.text: Betesayda: Betesayda issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati, «Betezata» geettes; birsheththayka, «Maaroteththa keeththa» guussa.
Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati taybo heedzdzas wurseththa bollafe biidi oyddu wurseth gakkanaas diza qofaa gujjettenna.
